notes.title: Artifact Seeker: Resurrection New DLCs Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/370b0f512698b3d03d8eaa9df0b2112fb68cd086.jpg[/img]

[h1]New DLCs are releasing now. [/h1]

[h2]One Free DLC[/h2]
A free DLC [b]Wandering Merchant[/b] with a new character and a bunch of new artifacts, events.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3518900


[b]New character, Aria the Wandering Merchant[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/12c57ee5d720777d665b02f55a5c46a262963d57.png[/img]
Aria wandered all the way from the far east, and she always found the best goods which no one cared where she got them from.
Characteristics: After Aria dashes, she will leave behind a phantom. Enemies that come into contact with the phantom will only feel a chill before losing their lives.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/5bf5b70b39ee8392e5bb37032423a0628f5cdec2.png[/img]

[h2]One Major Content DLC[/h2]
A new major content DLC [b]Shadow of the Deep Sea[/b] with 3 unique characters and a new map waiting for explore with a bunch number of new artifacts, skills, events……
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534930


[b]New character, Mermaid Princess Marisa[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/f7947234ede9127a6e99a0d0dd9fb131a89b9ce2.png[/img]
The Kingdom of Dark Sea, Tarasaya, coveted the artifact "Eternal Tide" and was annihilated by the Ancient Gods. Only Princess Marisa was sealed by her mother's magic into a crystal coffin and sunk into the Abyssal Shadow. A thousand years later, Marisa awoke to find only the remnants of her homeland turned into phosphorescent dust and mist. 
Characteristics: The princess is more adapted to fighting in the water.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/df2ba538eab915205fd00e3ca6dbea2f50c1068a.png[/img]

[b]New character Mysterious Captain Raven[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/2c826a31677d7d8c20f6a6b37ec922bd7d47b836.png[/img]
Many years ago, when she was serving on King Penguin's ship, Raven had seen the fragment of the Tarasaya chart in King Penguin's hand. This time, she gambled on the Serenity, not only for the treasure, but also to make her own reputation surpass that of King Penguin.
Characteristics: A patient gunner, she prefers to stand still and observe the enemy's weaknesses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/895ed5ceb463b634c40b74cd9e50c93dd07dc13b.png[/img]

[b]New character Gem Master Layla[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/5da66849f0b504b036d4c8fbd23227214d7eccc9.png[/img]
This gem master, whose pupils are filled with sparkling stars, claims to have been born in the rift of the sands of time. Travelers exchange their memories for the gems she carves, but they do not know that those gems are prophecies refined from the fragments of their own souls.
Characteristics: Layla always finds gems of higher quality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/9bf5ca065b63622e1171bdbb55501680e496ccd2.png[/img]


In addition, the DLC will also
- Add a new map Sea of Tarasaya, where dozens of new enemies will appear
- Add dozens of new artifacts
- Add dozens of new events
- Add some new Synergy
- Add new affixes
- Add more in-game achievements and Magic Court meta-progress
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/b76fb2ea15c913fbe0f6afd56ccd7dc342065677.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090863/afedc47d940c0b16b2813cb7c042b98576d94879.gif[/img]
[h2] Future New Mode[/h2]
We will also add a new more survivors-like mode as a lot of players ask for. (We don't have enough time to finish this mode when the new DLCs released, but it will be finished soon)

[h1]Big Thank You to All the Players[/h1]
2024 was a tough year for our team, but we survive! We can't make it without all the support from our players. Thank you for the support.

notes.title: Artifact Seeker: Resurrection will be released tomorrow on July 26th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423204/685720b4b291201964903ac49fc9dba1380e2abd.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054610/
Dear players,
The Artifact Seeker is reborn! The new DLC Legacy of Mortia will also be released simultaneously. Thank you for your long-term support. In the new DLC, you will experience:

New character, Ceratil the Battle Doll
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423204/b025d880c9f640c0a33858e037bafe975b8a8f2b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423204/bbfe169b49c094fa68d1b5585dba9d786070aa2d.png[/img][/url]
Ceratil, a name in the dwarven tongue that means “Ancient Guardian,” was the last of the ancient artifacts unearthed from the Mortia mines, meticulously crafted by the greatest magical artisans of an ancient kingdom long perished. Her form is exquisitely beautiful and indestructible, with an inner structure containing lost magics and technologies. Her gauntlets serve not only as weapons but also as conduits for interacting with the world, capable of manipulating elemental forces and the magic of ancient runes. Despite Ceratil’s almost impossibly endearing appearance, her true purpose and the role she played in Mortia’s demise remain enshrouded in mystery. 

Features: Ceratil doesn't like to make unnecessary moves. She either doesn't take action or kills the enemy instantly.

New character, Suraz the Artifact Collector
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423204/4a376efcc30f1e9eed5a4e2236b70511b7e82b79.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423204/de5a2b0d40539b7e89302654c4cad2d3ba5bb19d.png[/img][/url]
No one knows Suraz's past. All we know is that he has collected a lot of ancient artifacts, some of which do not belong to any era or civilization.

Features: Suraz's Grimoire will constantly change its form, and Suraz will continue to enchant and grow during the battle.

New character, Nargoth the Survivor of Mortia
